# NAMIWalks

> > NAMIWalks organizes community fundraising walks across the United States to raise awareness and funds for mental health programs through NAMI chapters.

NAMIWalks is the signature fundraising event series of the National Alliance on Mental Illness (NAMI), bringing together communities nationwide to support mental health awareness, education, and advocacy. Local NAMI chapters host walks in their regions, with events scheduled throughout the year, primarily in fall months.
